title: Two Meanings

serves.summary: The child hears a word with two meanings (bat, ring, bow, mouse) and drags the two pictures it names into the places beside the word, leaving out things that only go with one meaning or look like it, which shows identifying multiple meanings of common words.

request.topic: Words with more than one meaning
request.objective: Hear a common word with two meanings (bat, ring, bow, mouse) and show both meanings by picking the two pictures the word names. (LA005-02-G)

problems.ask: Bat. Find two pictures that are both called bat.
problems.goal: The flying bat and the bat for hitting. The ball (goes with the bat) is the miss.

problems.ask: Ring. Find two pictures that go with the word ring.
problems.goal: The finger ring and the bell that rings. The donut (ring-shaped) is the miss.

problems.ask: Bow. Find two pictures that are both called bow.
problems.goal: The ribbon bow and the bow for arrows. The gift (goes with the ribbon bow) is the miss.

problems.ask: Mouse. Find two pictures that are both called mouse.
problems.goal: The animal mouse and the computer mouse. The rat (the same kind of animal) is the miss.
